amap.plugin.title: AMap
amap.plugin.summary: Maps, place search and routes inside mainland China use AMap (enter a key in Settings · Data sources · AMap), with transit and live traffic for driving; chat card previews can use it too. This computer adds AMap's security code for the page. Disabled or removed, the map falls back to another provider
amap.plugin.keep.chat: Places mentioned in chats (that's chat history)
amap.plugin.purge.keys: The AMap key and security code you entered
amap.source.title: AMap
amap.source.summary: With a key, the map page uses AMap inside mainland China, and looking up places and routes there uses it too (only when you ask, the start, the destination or the "nearby" spot goes to AMap; without a key, China uses another map provider). The key stays on this computer; footprints and the points and lines ergo draws are drawn only on this device, on top of AMap, and chat card previews only ask AMap for the plain map of that area: AMap only knows which area you're looking at
amap.source.disconnectNote: The key and security code are deleted from this computer; the map page and lookups use another map provider instead
amap.configure.nothing: Enter the Web (JS API) key and its security code first
amap.configure.pairNeeded: The Web key and the security code go together (both from the same key in the AMap console)
amap.configure.badValue: Keys and security codes can't contain spaces or line breaks — check you didn't copy too much
amap.configure.keptOld: The new one didn't pass ({reason}); still using the old one
amap.preview.noKey: The AMap Web service key isn't set (Settings · Data sources · AMap)
amap.preview.key: AMap says the Web service key is wrong; enter it again
